question:
The following pie chart describes the number distribution of research scholars department-wise in a university. The strength of scholars of which two given subjects exceeds the combined strength of the scholars from Physics and Mathematics?

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/99ae9202f40ee299c562e77592b06b3ab8c41775d072422bdc7b68824632c2b3.png]
solution:
**Given:**

The following pie chart describes the number distribution of research scholars department-wise in a university.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/99ae9202f40ee299c562e77592b06b3ab8c41775d072422bdc7b68824632c2b3.png] 

**Calculations:**

According to the question,

Physics= 14%

Mathematics= 22%

Zoology = 22%

Hindi = 12%

Chemistry= 12%

Education= 17%

Now, Physics+ Mathematics = 14 + 22 = 36 %

Only, Zoology + Education= 22 + 18 = 40 % exceeds the combination of Physics and Mathematics.

**Hence, The Required answer is zoology and education.**
